strings.onboarding.mic.denied: Microphone access is needed to record your voice. Click Allow microphone to try again.
strings.onboarding.mic.blocked: Microphone access is off. Open Quill's app settings, choose Permissions, then allow Microphone. Return here to test it.
strings.settings.cleanup.automatic_help: Use the speech provider's active key with a known free cleanup option. Automatic cleanup stays off when no free option is known. Free-tier quotas apply. Choosing a separate provider or model below is a manual choice and may cost money.
strings.onboarding.splash.tagline: Speak, instead of typing, in any app. Quill is 100% free & 100% private.
strings.onboarding.welcome.title: Speak, instead of typing, in any app. For free.
strings.onboarding.welcome.body: A small bubble floats over the screen. Click it & speak. Your words appear where your cursor is.
strings.onboarding.key.warning.free_tier: You bring the key - some providers (like Groq) have a free tier to start.
strings.onboarding.key.warning.usage: Your provider may charge for usage - Quill itself is free.
strings.onboarding.key.warning.reading: Take a moment to read this
strings.onboarding.howitworks.title: From voice to text, on your terms
strings.onboarding.howitworks.step1: The bubble starts listening - click again to send.
strings.onboarding.howitworks.step2: Audio goes straight to your speech-to-text key. No middleman.
strings.onboarding.howitworks.step3: Text drops in at the cursor - chat, email, search, notes.
strings.onboarding.checklist.title: You're connected
strings.onboarding.key.title: Add your key
strings.onboarding.key.body: A key is a long private code from an AI service. It lets Quill send your voice to the AI & get text back over an encrypted connection. Never share your key with anyone.
strings.onboarding.key.where_link: Where do I get a key?
strings.onboarding.key.console_body: Any of these works - pick one for quick steps to get its key. Your key stays on this device.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.title: Get your %1$s key
strings.onboarding.key.guide.groq_steps:
Open https://console.groq.com/keys
Sign in, then choose Create API Key.
Give the key a name, such as Quill, and create it.
Copy the key, return to Quill, and paste it below.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.openai_steps:
Open https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
Sign in and choose Create new secret key.
Copy the new key before closing the dialog.
Return to Quill and paste it below.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.openrouter_steps:
Open https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys
Sign in, then create a new API key.
Name the key Quill and review its spending limit.
Copy the new key, return to Quill, and paste it below.
strings.onboarding.key.guide.gemini_steps:
Open https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys
Sign in to Google AI Studio and accept its terms if asked.
Copy an existing Gemini key, or choose Create API key and select a project.
Return to Quill and paste the key below.
strings.stt.quota.toast: API usage has run out - check your provider plan.
strings.key.error.invalid: That key was rejected (401). Check you copied it fully.
strings.key.error.network: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your connection and try again.
strings.onboarding.mic.title: Allow the microphone
strings.onboarding.mictest.title: Say something
strings.onboarding.mictest.body: Let's check your mic. Speak now - you should see the strokes move.
strings.onboarding.overlay.title: Allow the floating bubble
strings.onboarding.allset.title: You're ready to write
strings.onboarding.allset.body: The bubble is live. Open any app, focus a text field, and give it a try.
strings.onboarding.allset.look: Look for this in the corner of your screen.
strings.history.title: History
strings.history.empty.on_body: Your dictation transcripts show up here. Saved on this phone only.
strings.history.empty.off_body: Turn on Save dictation history in Settings to keep transcripts on this phone.
strings.history.clear.title: Delete all history?
strings.history.clear.body: This removes all %1$d saved dictations from this device. It can't be undone.
strings.home.banner.a11y_off_text: Accessibility is off - click to switch it back on.
strings.home.today.last_used_sub: Not yet - click the bubble to dictate in any app.
strings.home.tip.title: Touch the bubble to move and drop anywhere.
strings.home.tip.text: Long-press to dictate to the clipboard
strings.home.paused.banner_title: Turn Quill on to bring back the bubble.
strings.home.paused.banner_text: The bubble is hidden. Quill stays ready so you can bring it back anytime.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.speech.title: Speech & model
strings.settings.speech.language_help: English keeps mixed Hindi-English speech in Roman script ("aaj ka"). Auto-detect or Hindi give native script.
strings.settings.speech.gemini_caveat: Gemini is a chat model asked to transcribe - spoken commands may occasionally be paraphrased instead of written word-for-word.
strings.settings.speech.key_required: No API key saved for %1$s yet. Add one to dictate with this provider.
strings.settings.speech.model_field_hint: Exact model ID from your provider
strings.settings.speech.custom_url_help: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Quill calls <base URL>/audio/transcriptions with your key.
strings.settings.keys.title: API keys
strings.settings.keys.empty_body: Connect a speech provider with your own API key. You can add, switch or remove provider keys here.
strings.settings.keys.banner: Keys are protected by this Mac’s Keychain and never appear in logs. A key is sent only to its selected provider over HTTPS. Custom keys stay bound to the exact base URL at which you saved them.
strings.settings.keys.help: Your cleanup model reuses this key unless you add a separate one.
strings.settings.cleanup.title: Cleanup
strings.settings.cleanup.provider_help: Cleanup uses the selected provider and its saved key. All three writing styles apply here. If cleanup fails or takes too long, Quill keeps your original transcript.
strings.settings.cleanup.custom_endpoint: Custom cleanup shares the custom endpoint and key with transcription. Saving a different URL changes both.
strings.settings.cleanup.groq_key: Cleanup always runs on Groq - it uses your saved Groq key, not your active provider's.
strings.settings.cleanup.groq_missing: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key it's skipped and the raw transcript is inserted.
strings.settings.style.title: Writing style
strings.settings.style.intro: Match how you write in each app - more formal at work, more relaxed with friends.
strings.settings.style.formal_sub: Full sentences, always punctuated, no contractions
strings.settings.style.neutral_sub: Sentence case, standard punctuation, as you said it
strings.settings.style.needs_cleanup: Writing style rides on the AI cleanup pass - turn on "Clean up with AI" for it to apply.
strings.settings.style.needs_groq: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key, writing style won't be applied.
strings.settings.style.words_promise: Styles adjust punctuation, capitalization and contractions during cleanup.
strings.settings.style.help: Style is picked from the app you were in when you started speaking. Custom words are still applied last.
strings.settings.words.title: Custom words
strings.settings.words.body: Teach Quill names and terms it keeps mishearing. Each is matched and replaced after transcription.
strings.settings.words.empty_sub: Add a name, term or phrase to get started.
strings.settings.words.listening: Listening. Click Record again to finish.
strings.settings.words.err_key: Add an API key in Settings to use voice capture.
strings.settings.words.err_permission: Microphone access is needed to record.
strings.settings.vocab.title: Contacts vocabulary
strings.settings.vocab.body: Import names from your contacts so Quill can learn how the people you know are spelled. Names are stored only on this device and are never sent anywhere.
strings.settings.vocab.import_failed: Couldn't read contacts. The previous import was kept.
strings.settings.vocab.empty_sub: Import from contacts to see them here
strings.settings.vocab.permission_needed: Contacts access is needed to import names. You can grant it in system settings.
strings.settings.vocab.clear_confirm_body: This removes every imported contact name from this device. Your custom words are not affected.
strings.settings.audio.title: Audio & recording
strings.settings.audio.trigger_value: Press shortcut to start and stop
strings.settings.audio.silence_banner: In very noisy places this may not trigger - the max-length limit always applies.
strings.settings.privacy.title: Privacy and History
strings.settings.privacy.banner_text: Audio goes directly to your chosen speech provider. Optional cleanup sends the transcript to your chosen cleanup provider. Quill runs no account or data server. Keys, settings, contact names and history stay on this Mac. Private mode prevents new history entries. Pending recordings and undelivered words are encrypted on this Mac for recovery until you retry, copy, or discard them. Successful recordings are removed.
strings.settings.privacy.history_sub: Kept on this Mac, then auto-deleted
strings.settings.privacy.crash_sub: Only if a crash happens - you review first
strings.settings.privacy.diag_help: Reports include the error, app version and device - never your audio, text, clipboard, or key.
strings.settings.bubble.title: Appearance
strings.settings.bubble.help: The light ring keeps the optional floating control visible over other windows.
strings.settings.advanced.title: Advanced
strings.settings.advanced.endpoint_help: For any OpenAI-compatible provider. Changing this re-validates your key.
strings.settings.advanced.keepalive_sub: Restores the bubble at login when it is enabled. macOS may require you to allow the login item. Quill never restarts a recording after sleep or a crash.
strings.settings.advanced.battery_sub: Open battery settings → find Quill → allow unrestricted
strings.settings.advanced.clear_confirm_body: This removes your saved key, clears your dictation history and custom words, and resets every setting on this device. It can't be undone.
strings.settings.advanced.reset_confirm_body: Restores all preferences to their defaults. Your API key and dictation history are kept.
strings.settings.about.title: About
strings.settings.about.footer: Made for the speakers, not the typers.
strings.system.recovery.title: Quill stopped typing into apps
strings.system.recovery.banner_text: Your phone switched off Accessibility access - Quill can't insert text until it's back on.
strings.system.recovery.heading: Let's switch it back on
strings.system.recovery.body: Some phones turn this off to save battery. Turning it back on takes two taps.
strings.system.crash.title: Send crash report?
strings.system.crash.body: Quill closed unexpectedly last time. You can send a report to help fix it - here's exactly what it contains:
strings.system.crash.banner: Sent through your own share sheet - you choose the app, nothing auto-uploads.
strings.reliability.boot.title: Click to re-activate Quill
strings.reliability.boot.text: Your phone restarted. Open Quill to bring the bubble back.
strings.inject.failed.title: Copied to clipboard
strings.inject.failed.text: Couldn't insert here - paste your dictation manually.
strings.inject.revoked.title: Quill was turned off - copied instead
strings.inject.revoked.text: Accessibility is off, so Quill couldn't insert. Re-enable it, then paste.
strings.home.battery.title: Quill keeps getting stopped
strings.home.battery.text: Open battery settings, find Quill, and set it to Unrestricted so it stops getting killed.
strings.settings.survival.title: Help Quill survive
strings.settings.survival.body: Some phones (Honor, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung) aggressively stop background apps. To keep the bubble alive, allow Quill to auto-start / run in the background in your device's app-management settings.
strings.settings.survival.steps:
1. Open your device's app-launch or protected-apps settings.
2. Find Quill in the list.
3. Allow auto-start / background activity (and set battery to Unrestricted).
strings.settings.survival.fallback: Couldn't open it automatically on this device - open Settings ▸ Battery / App management and find Quill manually.
strings.notification.text.hidden: Bubble hidden - click Show Quill to bring it back.
strings.notification.text.recording: Recording… click the bubble to stop.
strings.bubble.dismiss.toast: Bubble hidden - shake your phone or click the notification to bring it back.
strings.bubble.bin.label: Drag here to hide
strings.bubble.autoreturn.toast: Quill's back. Drag the bubble to the bin to hide it again.
strings.compliance.rationale.mic: Quill needs the microphone to record what you dictate. Audio is sent only to the speech provider whose key you supply, and is deleted after a successful transcription.
strings.compliance.rationale.overlay: The floating bubble needs permission to display over other apps. That bubble is also what lets Quill record while you're in another app.
strings.compliance.rationale.accessibility: Quill uses macOS Accessibility to identify the focused text field, read its existing text and selection to preserve your work, and insert your dictation. Password and secure fields are excluded. Focused field contents are processed on this Mac and are not uploaded. Dictated audio and optional cleanup text go directly to the providers you choose. You can revoke access in System Settings at any time.
strings.compliance.privacy.promise: Quill has no account and runs no server. Your audio and transcripts stay on this device except for the direct, encrypted call to the provider you chose.
strings.compliance.key.required_title: You'll need your own API key
strings.compliance.key.required_body: Quill is bring-your-own-key: it transcribes using your own provider account (e.g. Groq or OpenAI). Without a key, Quill can't transcribe. Your key is encrypted on this device and never sent to us.
strings.compliance.privacy.welcome_pill: Your key, your audio - nothing through our servers
strings.models.fallback: Could not refresh. Showing saved or built-in choices.
strings.models.ranking: Free compatible models appear first, followed by dictation or cleanup candidates. Free-tier quotas apply; check your provider plan. Preview models can change or disappear.
strings.models.custom_refresh: Click Refresh to check this endpoint’s model list.
strings.onboarding.key.free_note: Provider usage limits and charges apply. Checking your key sends no audio.
strings.onboarding.key.router_note: OpenRouter may charge for transcription. Checking your key sends no audio; your model access and quota determine whether dictation is available.
strings.onboarding.key.format_help: Enter a complete key starting with %1$s.
strings.onboarding.key.unverified: We could not reach the provider to check this key. Your draft is kept securely. Check your connection, then try again.
strings.onboarding.key.storage_error: We could not save your key securely. Keep this screen open and try again.
strings.onboarding.key.read_steps: I have read the steps. I will return to Quill to paste my key.
strings.onboarding.key.browser_error: The browser could not open. Choose a default browser in macOS System Settings, then try again.
strings.mac.key.custom_check: Check this endpoint before saving. Editing the address does not send your draft key anywhere.
strings.mac.error.bad_key: That key was rejected. Check that you copied the complete key for this provider.
strings.mac.error.quota: Your provider account has run out of usage or credits. Check your plan, then retry.
strings.mac.error.rate_limit: Your provider is limiting requests. Wait a moment, then retry.
strings.mac.error.network: Could not reach your provider. Your recording is kept securely on this Mac so you can retry.
strings.mac.error.pending_storage: Quill could not read or save recovery data. Keep this window open and copy any available words before quitting.
strings.mac.error.clipboard: The clipboard is busy. Your words remain here. Try Copy again.
strings.mac.status.recovered: A previous dictation is ready to recover. Retry its recording, copy its words, or discard it.
strings.mac.status.pending_retry: Retry, copy, or discard the pending dictation before starting another.
strings.mac.error.timeout: The provider took too long. Retry the recording or cancel it.
strings.mac.error.endpoint: Enter an HTTPS base URL without a username, password, query, or fragment.
strings.mac.error.model: Choose a model or enter its exact model ID.
strings.mac.error.microphone: Microphone access is off. Allow Quill in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
strings.mac.error.accessibility: Allow Quill in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility to insert into apps.
strings.mac.error.no_field: Click a text field in another app, then use your dictation shortcut. To dictate to the clipboard, click and hold the floating control.
strings.mac.error.sensitive: Dictation is off in password and secure fields.
strings.mac.error.focus_changed: The text field changed. Your dictation is ready to copy; focus the intended field before pasting.
strings.mac.error.storage: Quill could not save data securely. Check available storage and access to this Mac.
strings.mac.error.provider: The provider did not return a complete transcript. Retry, or choose another model in Speech & model.
strings.mac.error.blocked: The provider blocked this recording and returned no transcript.
strings.mac.error.incomplete: The provider stopped before completing the transcript. Try a shorter recording.
strings.mac.error.login: Quill could not update its login item. Check Login Items in System Settings.
strings.mac.error.hotkey: Command–Option–Space is already in use. Use the bubble or menu bar to dictate, or release this shortcut in the other app.
strings.mac.error.contacts: Quill could not read contacts. Allow Contacts access in System Settings and try again. Your previous import is kept.
strings.mac.status.unconfirmed: The app accepted an insertion request, but Quill could not confirm the text. Check the field before pasting again. Your dictation is still available to copy.
strings.mac.status.ready_to_copy: Your dictation is ready. Copy it, then paste it into your chosen field.
strings.mac.status.pasted: Paste sent. Check the field; your dictation is still available to copy.
strings.mac.status.sleep_retry: Recording stopped for sleep. Your audio is still available to retry or cancel.
strings.mac.key.label: Key name (optional)
strings.mac.key.security: Keys are protected by this Mac’s Keychain and never appear in logs. A key is sent only to its selected provider over HTTPS. Custom keys stay bound to the exact base URL at which you saved them.
strings.mac.onboarding.overlay: Quill can float over other apps on macOS without a separate overlay permission. Show the bubble, then enable Accessibility so your words can be inserted into the focused field.
strings.mac.accessibility.disclosure: Quill uses macOS Accessibility to identify the focused text field, read its existing text and selection to preserve your work, and insert your dictation. Password and secure fields are excluded. Focused field contents are processed on this Mac and are not uploaded. Dictated audio and optional cleanup text go directly to the providers you choose. You can revoke access in System Settings at any time.
strings.mac.accessibility.consent: I understand and allow Quill to use Accessibility for dictation.
strings.mac.home.tip: Use your shortcut, or click the floating control to start and finish. Drag it to a screen edge, or to the bottom to hide it for 10 minutes. Click and hold to dictate to the clipboard.
strings.mac.hotkey.label: ⌘ Option Space — start or stop dictation
strings.mac.history.empty: Your dictation transcripts show up here. Saved on this Mac only.
strings.mac.history.off: Turn on Save dictation history in Privacy and History to keep transcripts on this Mac. Private mode always prevents saving.
strings.mac.models.offline: Live models could not be loaded. Your saved model and bundled choices are still available.
strings.mac.custom.key_scope: Changing the base URL requires saving and verifying a key for the new endpoint. An existing custom key is never sent to a different URL.
strings.mac.audio.silence: Silence auto-stop is on: a 2-second startup grace, then 3.5 seconds below a conservative quiet-room threshold.
strings.mac.audio.input: Uses the default macOS input device. Choose your microphone in System Settings → Sound → Input.
strings.mac.privacy.body: Audio goes directly to your chosen speech provider. Optional cleanup sends the transcript to your chosen cleanup provider. Quill runs no account or data server. Keys, settings, contact names and history stay on this Mac. Private mode prevents new history entries. Pending recordings and undelivered words are encrypted on this Mac for recovery until you retry, copy, or discard them. Successful recordings are removed.
strings.mac.login.help: Restores the bubble at login when it is enabled. macOS may require you to allow the login item. Quill never restarts a recording after sleep or a crash.
strings.mac.about.copy: All interface text is bundled with this app. Copy changes arrive only in a new app release.
strings.mac.legal.privacy: Quill is a bring-your-own-key dictation app. Recordings are sent directly to your chosen speech provider over HTTPS; optional cleanup sends dictated text directly to your chosen cleanup provider. Provider usage is subject to that provider’s terms. Quill has no account, data server, analytics or automatic report uploads. Keys are stored in Keychain. History is stored locally with a default 1-hour retention; private mode prevents new history. Imported contact names stay local. Accessibility is used to preserve and insert into the focused field; password fields are refused. You may delete keys, history and settings in Advanced.
strings.mac.legal.terms: Quill requires a supported provider account and your own API key. Your provider may charge for usage and impose limits. You are responsible for using your provider account in accordance with its terms. Review dictated text before sending it: transcription and cross-app insertion can be inaccurate or unsupported in some apps. This app does not provide emergency, medical, legal or financial services.

strings.desktop.setup.local: Your key. Your provider. Your words.
strings.desktop.setup.welcome_body: Click a text field. Press your shortcut. Speak, then press again to insert your words.
strings.desktop.setup.privacy_body: Quill connects directly to your speech provider. Choose who processes your recordings before you start.
strings.desktop.setup.provider_body: Add and verify a key. You can change providers, models and cleanup later in Settings.
strings.desktop.setup.access_title: Let your words reach your apps
strings.desktop.setup.shortcut_body: Focus a text field. Press your shortcut to start, speak, then press it again to finish.
strings.desktop.setup.controls: The floating control and tray menu are available too. Closing this window keeps Quill in the tray.
strings.desktop.setup.ready_title: Make room for your next thought.
strings.desktop.setup.ready_body: Your workspace has a practice field. Try a short dictation there, then use the same shortcut in your everyday apps.
strings.desktop.demo.label: Example dictation
strings.desktop.demo.spoken: Let's move our meeting to Thursday. I'll send the notes before then.
strings.desktop.practice.title: Practice here
strings.desktop.practice.body: Click the field, then press your dictation shortcut.
strings.desktop.workspace.title: Your workspace
strings.desktop.workspace.setup_needed: Finish connecting your provider and permissions to start dictating.
strings.desktop.setup.companion.welcome: From a thought to a finished sentence.
strings.desktop.setup.companion_body.welcome: A shortcut keeps your attention on what you are writing. Quill puts your words in the field you already have open.
strings.desktop.setup.companion_body.privacy: Your provider processes the recording with your own key. Quill does not route it through a Quill server. Check your provider's pricing and privacy terms.
strings.desktop.setup.companion_body.provider: Keys are encrypted on this device. Verifying a key checks authentication; it does not record speech or prove that model credits are available.
strings.desktop.setup.companion_body.audio: Test your usual microphone before dictating. This test stays on your device and is discarded; nothing is uploaded.
strings.desktop.setup.companion_body.access: Quill checks the focused field before inserting. Password fields are excluded. If an app cannot accept insertion, your transcript remains available to copy.
strings.desktop.setup.companion.shortcut: Stay in the app you are using.
strings.desktop.setup.companion_body.shortcut: Start and finish with your keyboard shortcut. The floating control is optional. You can always reopen Quill from its desktop menu.
strings.desktop.setup.companion.ready: Try it where you already write.
strings.desktop.setup.companion_body.ready: A short sentence is enough for your first try. Change providers, cleanup, writing style and history retention whenever you need to.
strings.mac.setup.audio_body: Allow microphone access, then start a local sound check. This test is discarded and never sent to a provider. If access was denied, enable Quill in System Settings and return.
strings.mac.setup.access_body: Enable Quill in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility. This lets Quill insert text into the field you choose. Return here after enabling it.
strings.mac.setup.controls: Use Command–Option–Space to start and finish. The optional floating control and menu bar are available too. Closing the window keeps Quill in the menu bar.
strings.mac.setup.finish: Keep Quill in the menu bar
strings.mac.setup.shortcut_unavailable: This shortcut is unavailable. Use the floating control or menu bar. Check other apps and macOS keyboard shortcuts before trying it again.
strings.desktop.setup.privacy_line: Your provider key. A direct connection. No Quill account.
strings.desktop.speech.body: Choose how your recordings become text.
